Scored against odds fetched fresh on 2026-09-19 (Claude's original prices, where recorded, are close but not always identical -- both are shown in the ledger). Method: independent Poisson goal model, per estimate_method below.
estimate_method: Conditional pre-match estimates using only the supplied news and results, without subsequent match information. For each fixture, I assign expected goals from a conservative qualitative team-strength prior, home advantage, and role-specific injury adjustments. Recent results receive limited weight; clustered absences matter more than raw injury counts, and uncertain availability reduces confidence. Independent Poisson goal distributions then generate all outcome probabilities; BTTS = (1−exp(−home expected goals)) × (1−exp(−away expected goals)). Expected goals are stated home/away in each explanation. Probabilities are rounded to three decimals, with win/draw/loss summing to 1. These are judgment-based estimates, not empirically validated calibration; confidence describes input reliability.
